Title: Owner successfully edits assignment metadata
Preconditions: 1. User is logged in as project owner | 2. Assignment exists on project | 3. Navigate to Project Details page
Steps: 1. Scroll to Assignment section | 2. Click "Edit Assignment" button | 3. Modify freelancer name field | 4. Modify description field | 5. Add optional notes | 6. Click "Save Changes" button
Test Data: freelancerName: "John Smith Updated" | description: "Updated assignment description with at least 10 characters" | notes: "Additional notes about the assignment"
Expected Result: Edit form appears with pre-filled values | All fields are editable | Changes are saved successfully | Assignment section refreshes showing updated values | Success state is shown | Edit mode exits automatically

Title: Complete assignment edit workflow from project detail to save
Preconditions: 1. User is logged in as project owner | 2. Project has an active assignment | 3. User is on Project Details page
Steps: 1. Navigate to project detail page via browse | 2. Scroll to Assignment section (or use tab navigation) | 3. Verify assignment details are displayed | 4. Click "Edit Assignment" button | 5. Form appears with pre-filled data | 6. Modify all editable fields (freelancerName, description, notes) | 7. Click "Save Changes" | 8. Verify assignment section updates
Test Data: freelancerName: "Jane Doe Modified" | description: "This is a complete end-to-end test description with sufficient length" | notes: "E2E test notes"
Expected Result: Navigation works correctly | Edit button is visible to owner | Form displays with correct pre-filled values | All fields accept input | Save triggers PUT /api/assignments/:id | Backend validates and updates MongoDB | Frontend reloads assignment data | UI reflects changes without page refresh

Expected Result: Edit form closes | No API call is made | Assignment section shows original unchanged values | Edit mode is exited | No error messages appear

Title: Owner views edit button only (bidder does not)
Preconditions: 1. Two users: one owner, one bidder | 2. Assignment exists on project | 3. Both users have access to project
Steps: 1. Login as project owner | 2. Navigate to Project Details | 3. Verify "Edit Assignment" button is visible | 4. Logout | 5. Login as assigned bidder | 6. Navigate to same project | 7. Verify "Edit Assignment" button is NOT visible
Test Data: owner user credentials | bidder user credentials
Expected Result: Owner sees "Edit Assignment" button | Bidder does NOT see "Edit Assignment" button | Only delete button visibility follows same pattern | Authorization is enforced on frontend and backend

Title: Unauthorized user attempts PUT via API directly
Preconditions: 1. User is NOT the project owner | 2. Assignment exists | 3. User has valid auth token
Steps: 1. Attempt direct API call: PUT /api/assignments/:id with valid data | 2. Observe response
Test Data: assignmentId: (valid ID) | requestBody: valid edit data | Authorization: bidder token (not owner)
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden | Error message: "Only the project owner can update this assignment" | Database is not modified | Authorization middleware blocks request
